bf-a3804b9e015833aff74a7f40.what: Inspector discovery accepts a package manifest symlinked outside the selected source directory.

bf-a3804b9e015833aff74a7f40.fixed_by: Canonicalize the source directory and package manifest, require the manifest to stay inside that directory, and return the canonical installation root. Real CLI replay rejects escaped manifests before initial compiler admission; valid alternate checkouts, relative paths, directory symlinks, reload/persistence and cance

bf-d473cff05bd0980858484be0.root_cause: packages/create-relkit/tests/executable.effect.test.ts runBun previously selected its executable from process.env.BUN. bf-a5676dfc2d59af8017c415c5.fixed_by: Allocate evidence with mkdtemp instead of accepting an output path; normalize/check the temporary app boundary before realpath and validate the canonical result; select archived phases from literal before/after/smoke returns.
